messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球直接向上拋出時，除了初始速度之外，球在空中受到的唯一力是重力（忽略空氣阻力）。  
因此它的加速度是恆定的，方向向下，大小為地球表面附近的重力加速度：

\[
a = -g \approx -9.8 \text{ m/s}^2
\]

（負號表示加速度指向地面，即向下。）  

所以不管你以多快的速度拋出，球在空中的加速度都保持在約 \(-9.8 \text{ m/s}^2\)。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration? Actually they ask: "What acceleration will it reach?" But acceleration is constant due to gravity: -9.8 m/s^2 downward. So answer: acceleration due to gravity ~ -9.8 m/s^2. They might want to use the function calculate_maximum_height? No, they ask about acceleration. So we can respond: acceleration is constant at -9.8 m/s^2 (downwards). Provide explanation.
